rVenue.name: CLEARPOOL EXECUTION SERVICES, LLC
rVenue.materialAspects: Northern Trust Securities, Inc. receives payment for order flow in the form of discounts, rebates, reductions of fees or credits. Such payment is variable based on the size and spread in the security at the time of order execution and averages less than $0.0018 per share. Under some circumstances, the amount of such remuneration may exceed the amount that NTSI is charged by such trading venues. This does not alter NTSI's policy to route customer orders to the trading center where it believes clients will receive the best execution, taking into account, among other factors, price, transaction cost, volatility, market depth, quality of service, speed and efficiency.
